title: PendingUpload
description: A CV that was uploaded but NOT yet turned into (or merged into) a candidate, because it looks like somebody already in the system without being provably the same person. NEW in contract v2.2.0. The rule: an EXACT normalized-email match auto-updates, no match at all auto-creates, and anything in between - same phone, or same full_name + applied_position - stops here for a human. A pending upload holds no candidate_id because no candidate row exists for it yet; it is not visible in GET /api/candidates and does not count towards the upload response's `count`.

pending_upload_id.description: UUID. Pass this to the resolution endpoints below.

extracted_preview.description: A deliberately small slice of the extraction - just enough for HR to compare the incoming CV against the suggested matches. The full extraction is applied only once the item is resolved.

email.description: '' when extraction found no email - which is the most common reason a file ends up here at all.

duplicate_candidates.description: The existing candidates this CV might belong to, in the order the matcher found them. Never empty. Show these next to `extracted_preview` so HR can tell whether it is the same person.

status.description: So HR can see they are mid-pipeline before overwriting them.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601. The 'update' resolution targets whichever of these was updated most recently.

uploaded_by.description: hr_accounts.account_id of whoever uploaded the file.

created_at.description: ISO 8601. The queue is ordered oldest-first.

candidate.description: The candidate the CV ended up on - the existing one for 'updated', the brand new one for 'created_new'.

endpoints.description: Not part of the payload - a summary of the API for Lanes A and B.
endpoints.GET /api/pending-uploads: Any logged-in account. Everything still awaiting a decision, oldest first. Use it to rebuild the prompt if the user closed the upload dialog without deciding - otherwise those CVs are simply never imported.
endpoints.POST /api/pending-uploads/{pending_uploa: 'Same person.' Merges the CV into an existing candidate using the normal re-upload policy (extraction fields overwritten; status / applied_position / location / before_rejected_status / comments preserved) and files the CV as that candidate's next resume version. It does NOT take a candidate_id: when several candidates matched, the server picks the one with the newest updated_at - the record HR is actually working on. -> 200 with resolvedResponse.

'Different person.' Creates a new candidate from the extraction, with the CV as version 1. The near-match is kept in the new candidate's `possible_duplicate_of` so it stays visible. -> 201 with resolvedResponse.
endpoints.DELETE /api/pending-uploads/{pending_upl: 'Neither - drop this file.' No candidate is created or touched. The decision is kept as an audit record but the stored CV bytes are deleted (PDPA: we should not hold a resume we decided not to keep). -> 200.
endpoints.409: Returned when the item was already resolved (someone else got there first, or a stale second tab), and when 'update' is called but every suggested candidate has since been deleted - in that case use create-new.
